policies.sourceText: A minimum grade of "C" in MEC 441 is required for the B.E. degree.
The grade point average of all required MEC courses and all technical electives must be at least 2.00. When a course is repeated, the higher grade will be used in calculating this average.

notes.text: Area of Interest and other CEAS students (excluding double major applicants) are admitted if they: have completed PHY 131 or PHY 126 or PHY 127 or equivalents; have one MEC course required for the major taken at Stony Brook; have 10 or more credits of mathematics, physics, and engineering courses taken at Stony Brook that satisfy the major's requirements; have a major GPA of at least 3.2 with no more than one grade below B-; and have not repeated any course required for the major. Requirements must be completed within one year of enrolling in the first course that applies toward major entry. Applications are due January 5 (Spring) and June 5 (Fall). Non-CEAS students and double major applicants follow a separate, competitive process contingent on program capacity.
When a course is repeated, the higher grade is used in calculating the required MEC course and technical elective GPA.

Per the sample sequence footnote, MEC 440 and MEC 441 partially satisfy the ESI, CER, SPK, WRTD, SBS+, STEM+, and EXP+ SBC categories. Contact the CEAS Undergraduate Student Office for more information.
The sample sequence footnote lists GEO 312 (Structure and Properties of Materials) as a basic science elective option; it does not appear in the Natural Sciences list above.

The accelerated B.E./M.S. program in mechanical engineering allows up to six graduate credits taken as an undergraduate to count toward both degrees. It is not modeled here; see the Graduate Catalog for requirements.
Completion of the major requires approximately 107 credits. Students should contact the undergraduate program coordinator and advisor for advising.
